sourceRefs.locator: Pars posterior 53–56. Camp in the Pineta, reported price of a measure of wheat, difficulties during the siege, entry into Ravenna and Odoacer’s death.
Part 1, pp. 19–21, entries for Italy under 489, 490, 492 and 493. Verona, the siege of Ravenna and the additional naval blockade from 492.

note.de: Nach dem Kampf an der Adda schloss Theoderich Odoaker in Ravenna ein. Eine Quelle überliefert einen außerordentlich hohen Getreidepreis in der belagerten Stadt.
note.en: After the battle on the Adda, Theoderic besieged Odoacer in Ravenna. A source records an exceptionally high price for wheat inside the besieged city.
